what: A recessed stone stele in the Starfall temple: a wide three-step base, an arched niche with two buttresses, and a five-point Star Crown floating above a low gold halo. The player claims the crown here; it must read from the isometric camera and at night.

dims.basis: 1u = 1 tile = 1m; deliberately wider and shallower than prop_altar (1.00x0.72): a 1.24u three-step base, 0.72u deep including the forward star halo, stepped stele top 2.02u and crown tip ~2.19u, below the 2.5u storey

views.why: commander camera looks down on the shrine; the arched niche and radial star crown must read at ~60px

style_notes: Low-poly diorama, palette-only. Stone #7A7F87, gold #D9A62E, arcane purple #6B3FA0 emissive. Never: smooth shading, invented hues, textures, un-beveled box stacks.
notes: Skill-built hero prop: bmesh parts, selective bevels, weighted normals, UV pack, LOD/collider finish. Deliberately a recessed stele + radial star crown, NOT the stepped pedestal + bowl + posts of prop_altar or models/altar.glb.
